map.按消费金额与百分比计算小费、总额及人均分摊: Compute the tip, total and per-person split from the bill amount and tip percentage
map.税额 = 消费金额 × 税率；小费金额 = 消费金额 × 小费比例（北美常见 1: Tax amount = bill × tax rate; tip amount = bill × tip percentage (North America commonly 15%, 18%, 20%, choose by service level); amount payable = bill + tax + tip; per-person split = amount payable ÷ number of diners, for quick estimates when dining abroad.
map.税率（%，仅显示参考）: Tax rate (%, shown for reference only)
map.几乎必须，低于 15% 视为不满: Almost mandatory; below 15% is viewed as dissatisfaction
map.部分餐厅已含服务费: Some restaurants already include a service charge
map.账单含 15% 服务费，可额外留零钱: The bill includes a 15% service charge; extra cash is optional
map.高档餐厅可给，零钱即可: Fine at upscale restaurants, just leave some cash
map.非强制，高档餐厅常见: Not mandatory, common at upscale restaurants
map.出国就餐前，按当地小费习惯（比例或固定）算应付小费、含小费总额及多人分摊，避免现: Before dining abroad, compute the tip, the total including tip and the per-person split from local tipping custom (percentage or fixed) so you are never caught guessing on site.
map.团建/聚餐 AA 时，把小费摊进人均，直接报每人应付，减少扯皮。: When splitting a group bill, fold the tip into the per-person amount and quote each person directly to reduce arguing.
map.对比「按比例」与「按服务档次预设」两种给法，选符合当地惯例又不显得吝啬的金额。: Compare the "by percentage" and "by service level preset" approaches and pick an amount that matches local custom without looking stingy.
map.小费=金额×比例=800×15%=120 元；含小费总额=800+120=920: Tip = amount × rate = 800×15% = 120 CNY; total including tip = 800+120 = 920 CNY; per person = 920/4 = 230 CNY. If local custom is 18%: tip = 144, total = 944, per person = 236. When switching currencies, convert the amount to local currency at the current rate first to avoid a currency mismatch.
map.各国小费比例多少？: What tip percentage do countries use?
map.美国堂食 15-20%（服务好取高）、酒吧约 1-2 美元/杯；日本/韩国通常不: US dine-in 15-20% (higher for good service), bars around 1-2 USD per drink; Japan and Korea usually do not tip; European restaurant bills often include service (look for "service compris"), so extra cash is enough. Follow destination custom; this tool only does the math, not the etiquette advice.
map.已经收了服务费还要给吗？: Should I still tip if service charge is already added?
map.账单标注「服务费已含/service charge」时一般不必另给；若服务特别好: When the bill states "service charge included / service charge", usually no extra tip is needed; if the service was excellent you may leave some cash. The tip in this tool is computed independently from the rate you enter, and whether to stack them is your call.
